setTransferParams(uint256,uint32).notice: Switch between Standard (maxFee 0, threshold 2000) and Fast (maxFee > 0, threshold 1000) transfers.

userdoc.notice: Same behaviour as USDCBridge, but on Circle CCTP V2 (CCTP V1 is shut down on Dec 1, 2026).         Holds USDC and, when the owner calls bridgeUSDC(), burns the full balance so it is minted         to `mintRecipient` on the destination domain.
